messages.subject: Project Redwood — completion statement and funds request
messages.plaintextBody:
Jane,

Completion statement attached. The balance due from the buyer on completion is £19,202,100, after credit for the 10% deposit, the rent apportionment (£161,630 credited to you), the service charge (£7,480 due to seller), transfer of the £180,000 rent deposit and the £38,750 arrears retention.

Separately you'll need £1,077,000 for SDLT and £1,105 for the Land Registry fee, payable after completion. Please arrange for the completion funds to reach our client account by 14 May.

James

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
DX 134777 Bishopsgate | +44 (0)20 7946 0500
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
